text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-what da heck?! I got a sunburn everywhere 'cept where my headband was!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dammit! I forgot to put sunscreen on!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Time to bust out the aloe vera.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross fusses over her skin in an uncharacteristic fashion…
